ledger: ANCHORS: A1 = long curved diner counter (staff side behind / customer side with stools in front); A2 = row of red stools on customer side; A3 = kitchen pass-through window at back wall; A4 = front windows with OPEN neon sign / booths on customer side
shot 1: 00:00-00:10.17, exterior wide, diner at dusk with semi truck at left; no people visible (sampling note: the 00:10.000 frame already shows shot 2 imagery)
shot 2: 00:10.21-00:18.69, interior medium looking at A3 along counter; waitress behind A1 (staff side), wiping counter, moves right toward coffee machine

shot 3: 00:18.71-00:27.10, interior wide from customer-side front end of A1; waitress behind A1 at right; man enters from back (~00:19) and walks along customer side past A2, sits on stool facing waitress ~00:24; waitress pours coffee across A1
shot 4: 00:27.13-00:32.31, close-up coffee pour; man's hand holds mug (customer side), pot enters from upper right (waitress side) - consistent with shot 3
shot 5: 00:32.33-00:36.44, insert plate of toast and egg; no people

shot 6: 00:36.46-00:44.94, same wide setup as shot 3; man seated facing camera with plate, waitress absent; man's jeans/knees visible on the customer side of A1's front panel while his torso/arms and plate are behind the countertop edge; he is not on the A2 stool row
shot 7: 00:44.96-00:51.35, reverse angle from behind counter; waitress behind counter in foreground wiping; man small at far counter end on customer side, in profile facing the counter
shot 8: 00:51.38-00:59.85, empty interior (shot-2 framing), dawn light - implied time skip, both people absent
shot 9: 00:59.88-01:09.06, interior wide, daylight; man on stool customer side of A1; waitress behind A1 moving between coffee machine and pass area
shot 10: 01:09.08-01:17.56, medium two-shot; man customer side left, waitress behind A1 right serving plate, then turns away and walks right behind counter

shot 11: 01:17.58-01:26.77, wide (shot-9 setup); waitress behind A1 opposite man (01:17-01:20), then within ~1 s (01:20.5-01:21.75) ends up on customer side seated beside man with no path around the counter end
shot 12: 01:26.79-01:35.23, medium two-shot from behind A1 toward A4; both seated on customer side, waitress on man's right - matches end of shot 11
shot 13: 01:35.25-01:37.40, empty sunlit interior - implied time skip
shot 14: 01:37.42-01:40.98, tabletop insert mug, hands leaving cash
shot 15: 01:41.00-01:46.00, through-window exterior; man walks to truck; waitress reflection in glass
shot 16: 01:46.00-01:50.19, over-shoulder: waitress seated in window booth (A4 side) watching man at truck

shot 17: 01:50.21-~01:58, sunlit wide (shot-9 setup); waitress on customer-side stool at A1, stands and leans across; from ~01:51.5 a second identical waitress appears at far end of A1 while first one crosses to staff side; two waitresses visible 01:51.5-01:57

findings.description: In the final sunlit wide shot the waitress stands up from a customer-side stool; at ~01:51.5 a second identically dressed waitress (blue shirt, white apron, bun) materialises at the far end of the counter near the OPEN-sign window while the first is still in the foreground. Both remain visible simultaneously through ~01:57 (one near the coffee machine, one at the far counter end). No second waitress exists anywhere else in the clip.

findings.invariant_violated: no passing through fixed geometry / no side-of-anchor change without crossing
findings.description: In shot 11 (wide) the waitress stands behind the counter (staff side) opposite the seated man at 01:20; by 01:21.75 she is on the customer side seated right beside him, her apron and legs overlapping the counter's front panel during the move. There is no walk around the counter end and only ~1 s elapses; she passes through the counter. Shot 12 then confirms her on the customer side.

After the cut at 00:36.458 the man sits facing camera with his torso, arms and plate behind the countertop edge while his jeans/knees are visible on the near (customer) side of the counter's front panel below the chrome edge; he is not on any stool in the row of stools beside him. He appears to sit through the counter rather than at it (in shot 3 he sat on a stool in profile on the customer side).

After leaning across from the customer-side stool, the foreground waitress moves to the staff side of the counter between ~01:51.75 and 01:52.5: her legs remain on the stool/customer side of the counter front while her torso moves behind the countertop, and she then walks behind the counter toward the coffee machine without going around the counter end.

Just before the cut at 01:50.208 the waitress is seated in a window booth watching the man at his truck, which is still parked outside; immediately after the cut she is seated on a counter stool across the room, in the same sunrise light and with no implied elapsed time.

findings.invariant_violated: facing direction consistency across reverse angle
findings.description: In shot 6 the man faces the front-end camera (toward the front windows) while seated at the counter; on the reverse cut at 00:44.958 the camera looks from behind the counter toward the front, so a front-facing man should show his face or back. Instead he is in profile at the far counter end facing along the counter. His orientation and stool position do not reconcile across the 180-degree cut.
